question: what does every threshold cost in recall, and can the cost be enumerated?

MIN_COMPARABLE_LENGTH.cost_is_exact_and_enumerated: all 6 are staged in relations.jsonl with importable=false. They are the AV 5.9 svaha formulae (dive svaha at 9 characters, prthivyai svaha at 14, antariksaya svaha at 16, each recurring once) and tasya vratyasya (AVS 15.15.1 == 15.18.1). This is the short-high-frequency-phrase case: the identity is exact and the claim is weak, so the pair is staged and flagged rather than either imported or silently dropped.
MIN_COMPARABLE_LENGTH.near_parallels_lost: not separately measurable -- an excluded mantra is never scored

MIN_FORMULA_WORDS.cost: a one-word repetition is a lexeme, and 2,038 of the 4,825 formulas are two-word. Measured in FORMULA_FAMILY_RECONSTRUCTION_V3 section 4 and reproduced here: 0 of 2,038 have both tokens at 5 folded characters or fewer, so MIN_FORMULA_CHARS already excludes function-word pairs.

MIN_FORMULA_CHARS.cost: no emitted formula sits at the floor, so the floor binds only on candidates

MIN_FORMULA_OCCURRENCES.cost: measured separately; see the min_formula_occurrences block below if present

measured_cost.maximality_not_applied: these are raw spans, so a long span and its sub-spans are counted separately; the figure is an upper bound on what lowering the floor to 2 would emit, not a formula count

MAX_NEAR_PARALLELS_PER_MANTRA.cost_is_enumerated: all 562 are written individually to rejected_pairs.jsonl with their similarity

NEAR_PARALLEL_FLOOR.cost_is_enumerated: all 1,101 are written individually to rejected_pairs.jsonl

lossless_prunes_that_cost_no_recall.why_lossless: similarity = 0.5*ngram + 0.5*lcs with both terms bounded by 1, so a pair below (0.72-0.5)/0.5 = 0.44 on either term provably cannot reach the floor. Counted separately from real floor rejections so the distinction stays visible.
